name: Scala
description: Code intelligence for Scala projects with Metals and Java 17 or newer.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Scala files. Metals starts when a Scala file opens in a project and stops when none are open. It uses Java 17 or newer from your computer.
